about: The falsifier: one observation written twice. Folded at its own root, obligations rendered 3761 receipt lines, five of them twice: the observed lines of examples/release/price.ts, thermometer.ts, in-phase.ts, withdrawal.ts and signature.ts, each as a cone and as a reading.
Read back, the copies are observations too, so each render doubles them: one, two, four.
